select jsonb_build_object(
  'tables', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table', c.relname, 'owner', pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner), 'rls', c.relrowsecurity, 'force_rls', c.relforcerowsecurity) order by c.relname) from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='public' and c.relkind='r'), '[]'::jsonb),
  'columns', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table', c.relname, 'column', a.attname, 'type', format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod), 'not_null', a.attnotnull, 'default', pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid)) order by c.relname,a.attnum) from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace join pg_attribute a on a.attrelid=c.oid and a.attnum>0 and not a.attisdropped left join pg_attrdef d on d.adrelid=c.oid and d.adnum=a.attnum where n.nspname='public' and c.relkind='r'), '[]'::jsonb),
  'constraints', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table', c.relname, 'name', k.conname, 'type', k.contype, 'definition', pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid), 'validated', k.convalidated) order by c.relname,k.conname) from pg_constraint k join pg_class c on c.oid=k.conrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='public' and c.relkind='r'), '[]'::jsonb),
  'indexes', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table', c.relname, 'name', ic.relname, 'definition', pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid), 'valid', i.indisvalid) order by c.relname,ic.relname) from pg_index i join pg_class c on c.oid=i.indrelid join pg_class ic on ic.oid=i.indexrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='public' and c.relkind='r'), '[]'::jsonb),
  'policies', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table', c.relname, 'name', p.polname, 'command', p.polcmd, 'permissive', p.polpermissive, 'roles', (select jsonb_agg(coalesce(r.rolname,'PUBLIC') order by coalesce(r.rolname,'PUBLIC')) from unnest(p.polroles) x(oid) left join pg_roles r on r.oid=x.oid), 'using', pg_get_expr(p.polqual,p.polrelid), 'check', pg_get_expr(p.polwithcheck,p.polrelid)) order by c.relname,p.polname) from pg_policy p join pg_class c on c.oid=p.polrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='public'), '[]'::jsonb),
  'table_grants', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table', c.relname, 'role', coalesce(r.rolname,'PUBLIC'), 'privilege', x.privilege_type, 'grantable', x.is_grantable) order by c.relname,coalesce(r.rolname,'PUBLIC'),x.privilege_type) from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace cross join lateral aclexplode(coalesce(c.relacl,acldefault('r',c.relowner))) x left join pg_roles r on r.oid=x.grantee where n.nspname='public' and c.relkind='r'), '[]'::jsonb),
  'column_grants', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table', c.relname, 'column', a.attname, 'role', coalesce(r.rolname,'PUBLIC'), 'privilege', x.privilege_type, 'grantable', x.is_grantable) order by c.relname,a.attname,coalesce(r.rolname,'PUBLIC'),x.privilege_type) from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace join pg_attribute a on a.attrelid=c.oid and a.attnum>0 and not a.attisdropped cross join lateral aclexplode(a.attacl) x left join pg_roles r on r.oid=x.grantee where n.nspname='public' and c.relkind='r'), '[]'::jsonb),
  'triggers', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table', c.relname, 'name', t.tgname, 'definition', pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid), 'enabled', t.tgenabled) order by c.relname,t.tgname) from pg_trigger t join pg_class c on c.oid=t.tgrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='public' and not t.tgisinternal), '[]'::jsonb),
  'extensions', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name', e.extname, 'version', e.extversion, 'schema', n.nspname) order by e.extname) from pg_extension e join pg_namespace n on n.oid=e.extnamespace), '[]'::jsonb),
  'functions', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name', p.proname, 'owner', pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner), 'arguments', pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid), 'result', pg_get_function_result(p.oid), 'security_definer', p.prosecdef, 'volatility', p.provolatile, 'config', p.proconfig, 'definition_sha256', encode(sha256(convert_to(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'UTF8')),'hex'), 'grants', (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',coalesce(r.rolname,'PUBLIC'),'privilege',x.privilege_type,'grantable',x.is_grantable) order by coalesce(r.rolname,'PUBLIC'),x.privilege_type) from aclexplode(coalesce(p.proacl,acldefault('f',p.proowner))) x left join pg_roles r on r.oid=x.grantee)) order by p.proname,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid)) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and p.prokind='f' and not exists (select 1 from pg_depend dep where dep.objid=p.oid and dep.classid='pg_proc'::regclass and dep.deptype='e')), '[]'::jsonb)
) as catalog;

-- Read-only aggregate post-C backfill verification; toxldjgwkxtneoqsazym, f9e1ac2. No private row fields returned.
with required as (
    select s.id, s.status, s.finalized_at, (s.h3_r8 is not null and s.h3_r6 is not null) as has_cells,
           count(distinct p.shot_type) filter (where p.shot_type in ('A', 'B')) as required_shot_count,
           max(p.qa_status) filter (where p.shot_type = 'A') as shot_a,
           max(p.qa_status) filter (where p.shot_type = 'B') as shot_b
    from public.submissions s left join public.photos p on p.submission_id = s.id
    group by s.id, s.status, s.finalized_at, s.h3_r8, s.h3_r6
), expected_status as (
    select status, case when finalized_at is null then 'pending'
                       when shot_a is null or shot_b is null then 'pending'
                       when shot_a = 'fail' or shot_b = 'fail' then 'qa_fail'
                       when shot_a in ('flagged', 'error') or shot_b in ('flagged', 'error') then 'flagged'
                       when not has_cells then 'pending'
                       else 'qa_pass' end as expected_status
    from required
), expected_photo_qa as (
    select p.qa_status,
        case when exists(select 1 from public.qa_jobs j where j.photo_id = p.id and j.status = 'completed') then
            case when exists(select 1 from public.qa_events e where e.submission_id = p.submission_id and not e.passed and e.check_name in ('sharpness_' || p.shot_type, 'exposure_' || p.shot_type, 'is_soil_' || p.shot_type)) then 'fail'
                 when exists(select 1 from public.qa_events e where e.submission_id = p.submission_id and not e.passed and e.check_name in ('gps_plausibility_' || p.shot_type, 'duplicate_' || p.shot_type)) then 'flagged'
                 else 'pass' end
             when exists(select 1 from public.qa_jobs j where j.photo_id = p.id and j.status = 'dead_letter') then 'error'
             else null end as expected_status
    from public.photos p
)
select jsonb_build_object(
    'contributor_count', (select count(*) from public.contributors),
    'actor_count', (select count(*) from public.actors),
    'human_actor_missing_or_duplicated_count', (select count(*) from public.contributors c where (select count(*) from public.actors a where a.kind = 'human' and a.contributor_id = c.id) <> 1),
    'actor_backfill_status_mismatch_count', (select count(*) from public.actors a join public.contributors c on c.id = a.contributor_id where a.kind <> 'human' or a.operator_id is not null or a.status is distinct from case when c.auth_uid is null then 'revoked' else 'active' end),
    'unexpected_actor_kind_or_orphan_count', (select count(*) from public.actors a where a.kind <> 'human' or not exists(select 1 from public.contributors c where c.id = a.contributor_id)),
    'submission_count', (select count(*) from public.submissions),
    'submission_actor_binding_mismatch_count', (select count(*) from public.submissions s left join public.actors a on a.id = s.actor_id where a.id is null or a.kind <> 'human' or a.contributor_id is distinct from s.contributor_id),
    'submission_tier_backfill_mismatch_count', (select count(*) from public.submissions s where s.provenance_tier is distinct from case when s.is_synthetic then -1 else 0 end),
    'submission_legacy_claim_mismatch_count', (select count(*) from public.submissions s where s.ingest_path <> 'web' or s.capture_method <> 'unknown' or s.location_source <> 'unknown' or s.client_version is not null),
    'synthetic_submission_count', (select count(*) from public.submissions where is_synthetic),
    'nonsynthetic_submission_count', (select count(*) from public.submissions where not is_synthetic),
    'invented_submission_tier_one_or_higher_count', (select count(*) from public.submissions where provenance_tier >= 1),
    'photo_count', (select count(*) from public.photos),
    'photo_tier_backfill_mismatch_count', (select count(*) from public.photos p join public.submissions s on s.id = p.submission_id where p.provenance_tier is distinct from case when s.is_synthetic then -1 else 0 end),
    'legacy_photo_evidence_nonnull_count', (select count(*) from public.photos where capture_evidence_private is not null),
    'grant_count', (select count(*) from public.contribution_grants),
    'legacy_grant_receipt_nonnull_count', (select count(*) from public.contribution_grants where received_at is not null),
    'legacy_grant_terms_missing_count', (select count(*) from public.contribution_grants g where not exists(select 1 from public.terms_versions t where t.version = g.terms_version)),
    'terms_total_count', (select count(*) from public.terms_versions),
    'terms_expected_count', (select 1 + count(distinct terms_version) from public.contribution_grants where terms_version <> '2026-07-22-v1'),
    'terms_july_published_unretired_count', (select count(*) from public.terms_versions where version = '2026-07-22-v1' and published_at <= now() and retired_at is null),
    'terms_other_retired_count', (select count(*) from public.terms_versions where version <> '2026-07-22-v1' and retired_at is not null),
    'terms_active_version_mismatch_count', (select count(*) from public.terms_versions where (version = '2026-07-22-v1') is distinct from (retired_at is null)),
    'gold_label_count', (select count(*) from public.gold_labels),
    'legacy_holdout_true_count', (select count(*) from public.gold_labels where holdout),
    'complete_ab_count', (select count(*) from required where required_shot_count = 2),
    'finalized_count', (select count(*) from required where finalized_at is not null),
    'finalization_mismatch_count', (select count(*) from required where (required_shot_count = 2) is distinct from (finalized_at is not null)),
    'photo_qa_backfill_mismatch_count', (select count(*) from expected_photo_qa where qa_status is distinct from expected_status),
    'settlement_mismatch_count', (select count(*) from expected_status where status is distinct from expected_status)
) as aggregate_backfill_counts;
prior_k:
select jsonb_build_object(
'observed_at_utc',to_char(clock_timestamp() at time zone 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US') || ' UTC',
'public_cells', (select count(*) from public.h3_cells),
'k_anonymity_violations',(select count(*) from public.h3_cells where n_contributors is null or n_contributors < 3 or n_submissions is null or n_submissions < n_contributors or resolution is null or resolution not in (4,6,8) or h3_index is null or h3_index !~ ('^8' || to_hex(resolution::integer) || '[0-9a-f]{13}$')),
'prior_cache_rows',(select count(*) from public.prior_cell_cache),
'prior_jobs_nonempty_new_empty_sources',(select count(*) from public.prior_jobs where empty_sources is distinct from '{}'::text[]),
'upstream_bucket_rows',(select count(*) from public.upstream_buckets),
'upstream_bucket_config_mismatch',(select count(*) from public.upstream_buckets b full join (values ('soilgrids',1,5::numeric,1::numeric),('ssurgo',30,30::numeric,30::numeric),('open_meteo',60,60::numeric,60::numeric)) e(source,capacity,refill_per_minute,tokens) on b.source=e.source where b.source is null or e.source is null or b.capacity is distinct from e.capacity or b.refill_per_minute is distinct from e.refill_per_minute or b.tokens is distinct from e.tokens)
) as checks;
